segments.text: Hey builders, welcome back to the channel.
Today we are building a secret piston door that hides inside a wall.
You only need four sticky pistons, some redstone dust and two levers.
First, dig a hole two blocks wide and three blocks tall.
Place two sticky pistons on each side, facing the middle of the doorway.
Then stick a stone block onto the face of every piston.
Now for the wiring. Run redstone dust behind the pistons on both sides.
The dust carries the signal, so both sides open at the same moment.
Connect the two lines under the floor and bring them up to a lever.
Okay, flip the lever and watch the wall slide open.
The pistons pull the blocks back and the doorway appears.
Flip it again and the wall closes like nothing was ever there.
Next, let us hide the lever so nobody can find the door.
Put a painting over the lever, or swap it for a button behind a bookshelf.
A bookshelf with one missing book is the classic secret switch.
Finally, add a repeater if you want the door to close by itself.
The repeater delays the signal, which gives you time to walk through.
And that is your secret piston door, ready for any base.
So if you enjoyed this build, the next video shows a hidden staircase.
